mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, the combined effect signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 QoQ < 0% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
